{{title}}

{% if badge %}{{badge}}{% endif %}

+

Typed inline signatures

+

+ An {t("{% inline %}")} may declare a typed parameter signature — + {t("{% inline \"card\" (title, badge=\"\") %}")} — named parameters, each with an + optional literal default (ADR-042 §8). + A call passes a hash: {t("{% include \"card\" title=x %}")} binds title, + and an omitted optional (badge) falls back to its default. A required argument + the call omits is a compile-time error in the typed AOT — the typed-macro check Tera's + untyped {t("{% macro %}")} can't give; the interpreter renders it leniently. The + signature binds at the include site and desugars to the existing partial machinery, so the + interpreter, the AOT-compiled Rust, and the VM render identically. +
